target.title: fix(ios): localize Agent Pro detail labels
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users viewing Agent Pro usage, skills, or automation details in a non-English locale still see the English labels and empty-state copy. The shared rows accepted `String` values, so SwiftUI treated the catalog-backed literals as stored strings and rendered them verbatim.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared Agent Pro helpers now accept the existing `OpenClawTextValue` boundary used by sibling Agent Pro components. Static labels and empty-state copy therefore retain their localized-key semantics, while runtime metric values remain explicitly verbatim. The i18n source contract and focused source guard cover both helpers.

## User Impact

Localized Agent Pro screens now translate the metric labels (`Cost`, `Tokens`, `Cache`, `Key`, `Source`, `Automations`, and `Next`) and empty-state titles/details without changing the displayed runtime values, icons, typography, or layout.

## Evidence

- Code scope: `apps/ios/Sources/Design/AgentProTab+DetailComponents.swift`, `scripts/apple-app-i18n.ts`, and `test/scripts/apple-app-i18n.test.ts` only.
- Static validation: `git diff --check` passed; all current helper call sites were re-read and keep static labels separate from runtime values.
- Apple contract: SwiftUI documents string literals/`LocalizedStringKey` as catalog lookups and `Text(verbatim:)` as the explicit non-localized path: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/text/init(_:tableName:bundle:comment:) and https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/text/init(verbatim:).
- Official PR CI: `ios-build`, `native-i18n`, `macos-swift`, `Real behavior proof`, and the required CI gate are green on head `b88578fe1e1216e7ede3b0e149df7db97f8e9bf5`.
- Hosted French Simulator proof (free `macos-26`, exact `main@faf3dbd` before vs this head after): [run](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/actions/runs/29650920486), [before artifact](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/actions/runs/29650920486/artifacts/8431525070), [after artifact](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/actions/runs/29650920486/artifacts/8431549636). Both PNGs are 1206x2622 with the same Usage route and viewport. Before shows English `Cost`, `Tokens`, and empty-state copy; after shows French `Coût`, `Jetons`, and the translated empty state. Runtime values (`7d`, `0`, `n/a`) remain unchanged; no overlap or blank surface was observed. The workflow compare job verified both artifacts and distinct rendered output hashes.

AI-assisted: Codex. I reviewed the changed helpers, all callers, the sibling implementation, the string catalog entries, and the SwiftUI API contract.
